question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Anguish
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anguish** (noun): Extreme pain, distress, or suffering. (पीड़ा)

 
 
• **Example**: The anguish of losing a loved one can be overwhelming.
 
 
 
• **Pain** (noun): Physical or mental suffering or discomfort.(दर्द)
 
 
• **Example:** The patient experienced intense pain after the surgery.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is** 'Pain.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) Gain** (लाभ) means to obtain or acquire something desirable, often related to profit or advantage.
 
• **Option 3) Restrain** (नियंत्रित करना) means to hold back or prevent someone or something from doing something.
 
• **Option 4) Obtain **(प्राप्त करना) means to acquire or get possession of something.
